title: Generate supercell structures
action: Construct 120-atom supercells for perfect 3C-SiC, Si, diamond and for configurations containing one twin boundary (…++++++-------…), as well as n intrinsic stacking faults (n=1..10) in 3C-SiC using Hägg notation and known lattice constants. Write the atomic coordinates for each configuration.
description: Generate all required supercell structures and store them (e.g., as JSON or Quantum ESPRESSO input files).

title: Run LDA-DFT geometry optimization and total energy calculations
action: For each supercell from step_01, perform a DFT calculation with LDA, norm-conserving pseudopotentials, a suitable plane-wave cutoff, and an appropriate k-point sampling. Fully relax atomic positions and extract the final total energy. Save all total energies.
description: Run Quantum ESPRESSO on all supercells, relax geometries, and collect total energies in a single structured file (energies.json) for downstream analysis.

title: Extract twin boundary formation energies
action: From the total energies in energies.json and the known interface area A, compute the formation energy per unit area for a twin boundary in each material. Write the results to formation_energies.csv.
description: Compute twin boundary formation energies and output a CSV with columns: material (string), formation_energy (float, unit mJ/m²).
output_schema: Columns: material, formation_energy. material is one of 'SiC', 'Si', 'diamond'. formation_energy is a float in mJ/m².

title: Extract stacking fault energy series
action: From the total energies of the nSF and (n-1)SF supercells for 3C-SiC, compute the n-th stacking fault energy γ_n = (E(n)-E(n-1))/A for n=1..10. Write the results to sf_energies.csv.
description: Compute the n-th stacking fault energy for 3C-SiC and output a CSV with columns: n (integer), sf_energy (float, unit mJ/m²). The series should show a strongly negative value for n=2.
output_schema: Columns: n, sf_energy. n is an integer from 1 to 10. sf_energy is a float in mJ/m².
